message: 三人寄れば問題な知恵
After getting the go-ahead from Helena, I went around telling my close friends about it.

name: Eddie
message: 「Oh, congrats, man」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not officially decided yet, though. I'm counting on you at tomorrow's general assembly」

name: Eddie
message: 「Yeah」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hey, hey, Synn-kun~」

name: Synn
message: 「What's up, Sacchin」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Have you seen Nana-chan~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? I could've sworn she went to find you」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh~ The Ryuusei Academy Kirakira Festival~」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. We'll go over the details at tomorrow's general assembly, though」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sounds fun~ Though it looks like it's gonna be rough for you, Synn-kun~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha...」
On top of that, I still have demon hunting to deal with, too.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, the harder the work, the better the payoff's gotta be」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Already calculating your reward in return, huh? Just as expected」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I see~ Wonder if there's anything I can help out with~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well~ I'd really appreciate it if you could help spread the word about this」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, speak of the devil~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Oh, Sacchin-senpai! Did you find Yuugiri-senpai?」
If I remember right, she's Nanaka's underclassman--a girl named Okamoto, I think.

name: Sacchin
message: 「So, like, the Student Council is apparently throwing a festival called KiraFes--」

name: Yumil
message: 「Ah. If it's about that, I already heard」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat」

name: Yumil
message: 「Pretty sure the Vice President told me to pass along her regards, too」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa did?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh, so the vice president's been talking to the first-years too」

name: Yumil
message: 「Looks like they've been going around talking to everyone in class about all sorts of stuff」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so~」
They're steadily putting in the work behind the scenes, huh.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, it's Nana」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hello--

name: Sacchin
message: Eh!? You're already at the shop?!」

name: Yumil
message: 「We're meeting at Chocolat, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Chocolat, you say……?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a cake shop in the shopping district. Those two are both members of the Sweets Club」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Jeez, and here I was waiting for you, Nana~」

name: Yumil
message: 「I figured she'd gone on ahead. She's pretty impatient, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, you know her well」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sorry about this, Synn~」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no. Take care and have fun~」
I wave goodbye and see the two of them off.

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's go too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Where do you think we'd get the money for that」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a spineless Demon Lord you are」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, if Kirafes succeeds, we might actually get to eat some cake」

name: Paqy
message: 「How does that work?」

name: Synn
message: 「We'll have them open a stall at Kirafes. Don't you think that'll massively boost our chances of getting to eat some?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh…… Planning to devour everything under the guise of 'taste-testing,' eh? As expected of you, Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「No, let's at least stick to the leftovers」

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright! Now that it's decided, let's head straight to this Chocolat place--」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure Nanaka will handle things well.」
It'd be a bit rude to ask her for a favor without even eating some cake, after all.

name: Synn
message: 「In the meantime, let's solidify our groundwork.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, got a second?」
I call out to the students I spot and try talking to them about Kirafes.
A lot of them had question marks floating over their heads at the sudden topic, but overall, everyone's reaction was good.

name: Azel
message: 「Not interested.」
Well, you get people like that every now and then.
If I'm going to do this, getting a little more in-depth with them would make things more certain, though.
Even so, quite a few of them already knew about this.
The source was, of course--

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chaaan.」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh.」

name: Misa
message: 「Shiooo.」

name: Shio
message: 「Whoa?!」
Getting called out to from the opposite side at the exact same time, Shio-chan gets all flustered.

name: Shio
message: 「Wh-Which of you should I greet first...」

name: Misa
message: 「Either one is fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「You can start with Misa.」

name: Shio
message: 「As you wish. Good day to you, Dear Sister. And a pleasant day to you as well, Lord Synn.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. Do you think that means you've conceded the win to me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「We're tied when it comes to Shio. I know all about it, you know--that you've been going around preaching about Kirafes too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like it. Word has gotten around more than I expected. At this rate, tomorrow's general assembly should go smoothly, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「That depends entirely on who's spreading the word.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What's that supposed to mean?」

name: Misa
message: 「Spouting nothing but sweet, fun-sounding promises to smoothly reel people in and drag them along.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How awful...」

name: Misa
message: 「You, I mean you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy. Was it really like that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wouldn't be weird if it looked that way.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'd expect nothing less from you, Paqy. That's how someone who knows the difference ought to be.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, being so damn serious that the content doesn't grab anyone's interest is also a problem.」

name: Misa
message: 「*Gulp*」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that true, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nobody ever said it was about me!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Um... What manner of business might you have with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. Well, actually...」
Before she can complain about anything, I steal a quick glance at Misa to gauge her reaction.

name: Misa
message: 「You can go ahead first here.」
She's strangely principled in the weirdest places.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, actually, it's about Kira―Fes―」
And so on and so forth.

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm... I see. And what, pray tell, is Sister's side of the argument?」

name: Misa
message: 「Alright, my turn!」
The two of them finish their speeches.

name: Shio
message: 「So, whether to hold it or not. The question comes down to which option would be preferable, does it not?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes... whether we managed to make a case that makes you want to vote in favor at tomorrow's general meeting.」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. Allow me to speak candidly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ba-dump...\s03」

name: Shio
message: 「Katsu!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's wrong, Shio? Did something upset you...」

name: Shio
message: 「Fufufu... hahaha! I am a fortunate man indeed. After all, I have gained the deepest understanding of this event in the entire academy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? What do you mean by that?」

name: Shio
message: 「At first, I was somewhat perplexed by Sir Synn's explanation, yet with Elder Sister's supplement, it has come to make complete sense」

name: Misa
message: 「See~? Just like I told you\s04」

name: Shio
message: 「However, in the reverse case. Had I heard Elder Sister's explanation first... I would have lost all desire to hear anything further」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-Wha--」

name: Paqy
message: 「These guys are idiots. If the two of 'em teamed up, they could fool way more students, hehehe」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How wicked...」

name: Shio
message: 「For a mere apparition, it comes up with a clever scheme. What say you to that, Sir Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「J-Just Misa and me, together...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey! Needing the two of us to do it together would just be embarrassing, wouldn't it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh, true. Being all alone together... would be embarrassing\s03」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh? Wh-wh-wh-what are you talking about, that's not what I meant--」

name: Misa
message: 「~~!! Now you've made me forget what I was even going to say\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I get it. Basically, if we each understand it, we can do it solo, so there's no need to go out of our way to do it together?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, that! So I'll memorize what you said, and you memorize what I said!!」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Got it」

name: Misa
message: 「Then let's practice」

name: Shio
message: 「Hahaha. You two are certainly on close terms」

name: Misa
message: 「How on earth does it look like that from any angle!!」
Needless to say, the sun went down with them doing nothing but practicing.
